info.description:
Private reproductive-health education engineering prototype for adults 18+. Use synthetic inputs only. This API does not diagnose, assess symptoms, provide treatment, or perform emergency screening.

The education endpoint is an unavailable stub: valid requests return HTTP 200 with application status `service_unavailable`, no medical answer, and no sources. Retrieval, safety screening, evidence assessment, and model generation are not connected to this route. Other answer-status enum values are reserved for future reviewed behavior. Health reports liveness only.

These docs do not establish clinical validation or approval for public use. Do not enter real health information or secrets.
info.title: AfyaHer private prototype API
